Consequently, method rankings change across metrics and variables. These results show that there is no single best downscaling method. Multi metric evaluation is therefore essential for assessing which properties of a climate field are preserved.

</details>


### [226] [Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01590)
*Yuan Huang,Zihan Chen,Runbin Zhang,Hongwei Ding,Changzeng Fu,Shiqi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LS-B方法，利用冻结fMRI编码模型观察首个任务，将任务特定适配器一次性分配给跨任务变化最大、结构最稳定的区块，从而免搜索地确定ViT中适配器放置位置，在多项基准上取得与搜索法相当甚至更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习中在每个ViT区块都保留任务特定适配器会导致存储随任务数线性增长，而仅在少数区块放置适配器虽可抑制增长，却带来"放在哪里"的关键问题；同时训练成本高的放置搜索不切实际，作者希望寻找一种无需标签、无需反向传播的外部信号来指导层特化。

Method: 从算法角度，穷举训练所有连续四区块配置，发现最终准确率随深度呈倒U型并于中间深度达到峰值（波动达3.5个百分点），而基于权重谱或激活统计的廉价准则偏好最深层区块。受视觉皮层分层组织与中间阶段可塑性启发，提出LS-B：用十二个人类视觉区的冻结fMRI编码模型观察首个任务，将任务特定容量一次性分配给读出差值相对其稳定结构最大的区块，无需放置搜索。在三个ViT-B/16骨干网络（AugReg、iBOT及另一个）上验证。

Result: LS-B产生稳定且骨干特有的分配方案；在AugReg与iBOT两个可做放置搜索的骨干上，所选区块与搜索确定的中间深度区域重叠；在匹配存储与观测预算下，所选区块优于最浅和最深的四区块配置。在Split ImageNet-R上，LS-B仅用完整BiLoRA适配器存储的60%，最终准确率差距在1.5个百分点以内；该分配无需标签或反向传播，运行时增加不足0.6%，并呈现骨干特异的皮层特征。

Conclusion: 研究表明，来自学习者外部的神经科学测量（fMRI编码模型的视觉区读出）可作为高效信号指导适配器的层特化，无需昂贵的放置搜索即可获得接近甚至优于搜索法、且显著节省存储的持续学习效果。

Abstract: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.

</details>


### [227] [Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01601)
*Guy Amit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"候选独立块因果注意力"（candidate-independent block-causal attention），通过阻断候选之间的信息流并重置候选位置编码，缓解决策模型对候选序列排列顺序的敏感性，同时保持决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型常将变长的候选动作集合编码在单一序列中评分，这一设定在生成式系统的 System 1 组件中日益重要，因为候选的提出或排序在不同运行间可能不同。标准因果交叉编码虽表达力强，但会使候选得分依赖序列化顺序而非底层决策问题本身，即存在排列敏感性。

Method: 提出候选独立块因果注意力：在共享上下文和每个候选内部保留因果计算，同时阻断跨候选的信息流，并对候选位置进行重置（position resetting）。在 Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B 和 Qwen3 4B 三种骨干模型上，与标准因果注意力和互补的不变性基线进行对比；并做消融实验，以及使用更多训练数据的 Qwen3-4B 扩展研究。

Result: 候选独立注意力一致性地降低了排列敏感性，同时保持了有竞争力的决策质量。消融实验表明候选隔离是该效果的主要来源，位置重置进一步补全了预期中的对称性。Qwen3-4B 的更大规模研究进一步考察了该架构在显著更多训练数据下的表现。

Conclusion: 候选独立块因果注意力是一种有效提升决策模型排列不变性、且不牺牲决策质量的方法；其核心机制是候选隔离与位置重置。代码与 Qwen3-4B 模型权重已开源。

Abstract: Decision models often score a variable-sized set of candidate actions encoded in a single sequence. This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions. We compare this architecture with standard causal attention and complementary invariant baselines across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B, and Qwen3 4B backbones. Candidate-independent attention consistently reduces permutation sensitivity while retaining competitive decision quality; ablations indicate that candidate isolation is the primary source of the effect, with position resetting completing the intended symmetry. A larger Qwen3-4B study further examines the behavior of the proposed architecture with substantially more training data. Code is available at the \href{https://github.com/guyAmit/ci-decision-models}{\textcolor{blue}{project repository}}, and the \href{https://huggingface.co/Guy-Amit/qwen3-4b-ci-decision-4096-poc}{\textcolor{blue}{Qwen3-4B model artifact}} is available on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [228] [Exposing the Cost of Deep Learning Audio Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01619)
*Constance Douwes,Paul Magron,Romain Serizel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出一种基于Grid5000计算平台活动日志的方法，估算深度学习音频项目在开发阶段（架构原型设计与大量实验）的能耗成本，发现其能耗是训练最佳模型单独能耗的3至256倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注模型训练与推理阶段的能耗与碳排放，而往往忽略了整个开发阶段的能耗。然而，架构原型设计与密集实验正是在这一阶段进行，能耗需求极高，因此需要对该阶段的环境影响进行评估。

Method: 提出一种能耗估算方法，基于LORIA实验室所使用的Grid5000共享计算平台的活动日志进行估算；以Multispeech研究团队开发的音频项目为案例研究。

Result: 评估了四个项目的整体能耗，并将其与训练所报告模型的能耗进行对比，结果显示开发阶段所需能耗是单独训练最佳性能模型的3至256倍。

Conclusion: 研究结果倡导对基于深度学习的音频项目在整个生命周期内更系统性地报告能耗。

Abstract: The environmental impact of deep learning has attracted increasing attention over the past decade. Existing studies mainly focus on the energy and carbon emissions of model training and inference, while the whole development phase is often overlooked. Yet, architecture prototyping and intensive experiments are conducted during this stage, which is highly energy-demanding. In this article, we propose a methodology to estimate these costs, based on activity logs from the Grid5000 shared computing platform used by the LORIA laboratory. As a case-study, we focus on audio projects developed in the Multispeech research team. We evaluate the overall energy cost of four projects, and we compare them to those of training the reported models. Our results show that the energy required for the development phase is 3 to 256 times greater than that required to train the best-performing model alone. These results advocate for a more systematic reporting of energy consumption across the entire life cycle of deep learning-based audio projects.

</details>


### [229] [Generalization in Neural Networks Through the Lens of Magnitude Potential](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01633)
*Sahel Torkamani,Henry Gouk,Rik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"幅度势"（magnitude potential）这一基于度量幅度理论的量，度量任意点被给定集合表示的程度，并证明其在神经网络泛化与训练动态分析中具有多方面价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络泛化与训练动态的机理仍缺乏统一解释，已有方法多从不同侧面切入，亟需一个能刻画点与集合几何关系、且可迁移到多种现象的基础量。

Method: 基于度量幅度理论定义幅度势，取某类别的幅度势与整个数据集的幅度势之比，在logit层计算该比值作为单个数据点的表示度量，并在个体与聚合两个层面进行实验分析。

Result: 单个训练点的幅度势比值与Feldman记忆分数相关；跨点聚合的比值能检测决策边界的结构性变化，并为模算术中的grokking提供几何指标；即使显式抑制神经坍缩，该比值仍具信息量。

Conclusion: 幅度势比值是一种有效的几何分析工具，可统一刻画记忆、决策边界演化与grokking等现象，并与神经坍缩互补而非冗余。

Abstract: Explaining generalization and training dynamics in neural networks remains a challenge, and various approaches have been developed to study different aspects of these phenomena. In this paper, we introduce the idea of {\em magnitude potential} -- a quantity based on the theory of metric magnitude -- that reflects how well an arbitrary point is represented by a given set. We find that this basic quantity can be applied to examine various features in neural generalization. The ratio between the magnitude potential with respect to a class and with respect to the entire data, computed at the logit layer, is informative of the representation of the point. In experiments, these ratios for individual training points are found to be correlated with the Feldman memorization scores. Magnitude potential ratios aggregated across points detect structural changes in the decision boundaries and provide a geometric indicator of grokking in modular arithmetic. Although the magnitude potential ratio and neural collapse are both closely associated with intra-class and inter-class geometric structure, the magnitude potential ratio remains informative even when neural collapse is explicitly suppressed.

</details>


### [230] [FedSAP: Federated Learning with Structured Adaptive Partitioning for Multi-Domain Heterogeneous Edge Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01638)
*Wentao Yue,Tianyou Lai,Hongji Li,Qingyu Mao,Qilei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedSAP，一种域感知的异构联邦学习框架，将结构化剪枝建模为预算约束下的三态通道分配，通过全局池、伪域私有池与丢弃态的划分，在异构客户端上实现资源自适应与域泛化的协同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构边缘设备上的联邦学习需同时应对不均衡的资源预算与域偏移的本地数据。现有资源自适应方法仅决定各客户端训练模型的比例，却未考虑保留容量应位于何处、如何共享；联邦域泛化方法通常假设共享完整架构。统一压缩会丢弃高价值通道，单一聚合路径会混合可迁移特征与域敏感更新。

Method: FedSAP将结构化剪枝转化为预算约束下的三态通道分配：将每个保留率转换为非均匀的层级预算，把稳定通道分配至Global池、有用的域敏感通道分配至伪域私有（Private）池、低效用通道置为Dropped态。该划分使广泛有用的特征受益于跨客户端池化，同时将域敏感更新与不兼容客户端隔离。域引导分配（Domain-Guided Assignment）基于浅层梯度相似度推断伪域；类型匹配聚合（Type-Matched Aggregation）将每个通道限制在其预期的共享范围内。

Result: 在三个随机种子上，FedSAP在Digits和Office-Caltech数据集上分别达到76.00%和72.67%的平均全局准确率，超越最强基线1.70和4.92个百分点，同时在异构客户端上支持高达80%的客户端剪枝率。

Conclusion: FedSAP通过三态通道分配与类型匹配聚合，在统一框架内协同解决资源异构与域偏移问题，在显著剪枝（最高80%）条件下仍取得优于基线的全局准确率。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) on heterogeneous edge devices must jointly accommodate unequal resource budgets and domain-shifted local data. Existing resource-adaptive methods decide how much of a model each client trains but not where retained capacity should reside or how it should be shared, whereas federated domain-generalization methods usually assume a shared full architecture. Uniform compression can therefore discard high-utility channels, and a single aggregation path can mix transferable features with domain-sensitive updates. We propose FedSAP, a domain-aware heterogeneous FL framework that casts structured pruning as budget-constrained tri-state channel allocation. FedSAP converts each keep ratio into non-uniform layer budgets, assigns stable channels to a Global pool, useful domain-sensitive channels to pseudo-domain-specific Private pools, and low-utility channels to a Dropped state. This partition lets broadly useful features benefit from cross-client pooling while isolating domain-sensitive updates from incompatible clients. Domain-Guided Assignment infers pseudo-domains from shallow-gradient similarity, while Type-Matched Aggregation restricts each channel to its intended sharing scope. Across three random seeds, FedSAP reaches 76.00% and 72.67% mean global accuracy on Digits and Office-Caltech, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.70 and 4.92 percentage points while supporting client pruning ratios of up to 80% across heterogeneous clients.

</details>


### [231] [MCIR: A Feature Dependence-Aware Explainability Method with Reliability Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01641)
*Poushali Sengupta,Sabita Maharjan,Frank Eliassen,Shashi Raj Pandey,Yan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出依赖感知的全局特征重要性方法 MCIR-M，通过相互相关影响比率（MCIR）量化每个特征在依赖邻域之外贡献的独特预测信息，并在合成冗余实验与 UCI HAR 基准上验证其依赖感知排序行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习模型常包含强依赖或冗余特征，共享的预测信息会分散在相关预测变量中，导致 SHAP、LIME、HSIC、MI/CMI、SAGE 等现有特征归因方法在多重共线性或近重复预测变量下产生不稳定排序。因此需要一种依赖感知的全局特征重要性度量。

Method: 提出 Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio Method（MCIR-M）。核心指标 MCIR 将每个特征以其强依赖邻居为条件，计算条件信息与块级信息的归一化比率；总体得分落在 [0,1]，在精确条件冗余下等于零。同时引入轻量级估计流程，仅用部分可用数据计算 MCIR，并通过排序、头部集合和忠实性诊断评估其与全数据解释的一致性。

Result: 在受控合成冗余实验和 UCI HAR 基准上，MCIR 表现出依赖感知的排序行为，在注入近重复预测变量时优势最明显。与独立及条件 SHAP、SAGE、HSIC、基于 MI 的分数以及 CIR 族基线的比较在真实数据指标上结果不一。减少解释样本可降低评估配置下的计算负担。

Conclusion: MCIR-M 为强特征依赖下的全局解释提供了一种实用的依赖感知诊断工具。

Abstract: Modern machine-learning models often contain strongly dependent or redundant features, making feature attribution difficult because shared predictive information can be distributed across correlated predictors. Existing methods such as SHAP, LIME, HSIC, MI/CMI, and SAGE may therefore produce unstable rankings under multicollinearity or near-duplicate predictors. We propose the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio Method (MCIR-M), a dependence-aware global feature-importance approach that quantifies the unique predictive information contributed by each feature beyond a selected dependence neighbourhood. MCIR-M introduces the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio (MCIR), which conditions each feature on strongly dependent neighbours and computes a normalized ratio of conditional to block-level information. The population score lies in [0,1] and equals zero under exact conditional redundancy. We also introduce a lightweight estimation procedure that computes MCIR using a fraction of the available data and evaluates agreement with full-data explanations. Across controlled synthetic redundancy experiments and the UCI HAR benchmark, MCIR shows dependence-aware ranking behaviour, with its clearest advantage under injected near-duplicate predictors. Comparisons with independent and conditional SHAP, SAGE, HSIC, MI-based scores, and CIR-family baselines are mixed across real-data criteria. Reduced explanation samples lower computational burden in the evaluated configurations, while agreement with full-data explanations is assessed separately through ranking, head-set, and faithfulness diagnostics. Overall, MCIR-M provides a practical dependence-aware diagnostic for global explanation under strong feature dependence.

</details>


### [232] [Beyond Demographic Balance: Multi-Metric and Intersectional Evaluation of Fairness in MIMIC-IV Mortality Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01645)
*Abdullah Al Noman,Fahmid Al Rifat,Tahrima Hashem,Syed Muhammad Ibne Zulfiker,Rishov Paul,Tanzima HAshem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在MIMIC-IV的ICU死亡率预测中，公平性结论强烈依赖评估指标（准确率/AUROC、敏感度、假阳性率）与人口统计学分辨层级（边缘 vs. 三重交叉子群），边缘汇总会掩盖子群内异质性误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床预测模型的公平性评估常被简化为单一指标或边缘人口统计汇总，可能导致对公平性干预效果的误判。作者希望系统考察指标选择与子群分辨率如何共同影响公平性结论，并将"人口统计表示平衡"这一干预目标与"结果条件化/误差率"干预区分开来检验。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV上重访ICU死亡率预测的评估选择：对比多种公平性干预在预测效用指标与子群误差指标下的表现。引入一种轻量适配策略，在不以死亡率结果为条件的前提下，联合平衡种族—性别—保险的表示。分别在边缘层级与对应的三重交叉子群层级评估其行为，并考虑细粒度估计的统计支持度（样本量可靠性）。

Result: 同一干预在准确率/AUROC、敏感度、假阳性率下可能得到显著不同的评价；边缘人口统计汇总会掩盖其组成交叉子群内部的异质性误差分布，且这一现象在较大子群中同样存在。

Conclusion: 公平性干预的评估应同时在互补的指标维度与子群分辨率上进行，并需考虑干预目标本身以及子群估计的可靠性。

Abstract: Fairness conclusions in clinical prediction can depend strongly on both the metrics reported and the demographic resolution at which performance is evaluated. We revisit these evaluation choices for ICU mortality prediction on MIMIC-IV, comparing predictive-utility and subgroup-error metrics across several fairness interventions. As a complementary case study, we introduce a lightweight adaptation strategy that jointly balances ethnicity--gender--insurance representation without conditioning on mortality outcomes, allowing demographic representation balancing to be examined separately from outcome-conditioned or direct error-rate interventions. We evaluate its behavior at both marginal and corresponding three-way intersectional subgroup levels, while accounting for the statistical support of finer-grained estimates. The results show that interventions can receive substantially different assessments across accuracy/AUROC, sensitivity, and false-positive rate, and that marginal demographic summaries can conceal heterogeneous error profiles within their constituent intersections, including among larger subgroups. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating fairness interventions at both complementary metric and subgroup resolutions, while accounting for the intervention target and the reliability of subgroup estimates.

</details>


### [233] [CrossGMN: Graph Metanetworks for Cross-Architecture Weight-Space Transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01649)
*Adir Dayan,Yam Eitan,Haggai Maron*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CrossGMN，一种面向跨架构任务的等变权重空间图元网络，通过同时输入源网络与目标网络初始化，实现源置换不变、目标置换等变的跨网络消息传递，在模型压缩与知识蒸馏加速上取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有等变权重空间架构主要针对保持网络结构不变的变换设计，而模型压缩、升维等实际变换会将已训练源网络映射到结构不同的目标网络。此时源与目标的神经元置换对称性作用于不同参数空间，等变性难以直接定义，导致等变设计原则在跨架构场景下失效。

Method: 关键思路是将跨架构算子重新表述为双输入形式：一个已训练源网络加一个目标网络初始化。由此定义等变跨架构算子，用源网络信息精炼目标初始化，同时满足对源网络置换不变、对目标网络置换等变。据此提出 CrossGMN：一种图元网络，通过保持对称性的跨网络消息传递联合处理两个网络。

Result: 理论上证明 CrossGMN 在一般位置假设下、对紧集上的连续跨架构算子具有通用性。实验在模型压缩任务中预测小网络参数以加速后续知识蒸馏：在二维/三维 INR 以及 MLP、CNN、Vision Transformer 的图像分类上，蒸馏加速最高达 8.89 倍，跨数据集迁移无需重训可达 3.78 倍，且单一模型即可支持从异构源架构压缩到统一目标架构。

Conclusion: CrossGMN 为跨架构权重空间学习提供了等变且通用的框架，验证了双输入重表述在跨结构变换中的有效性，并在压缩与蒸馏加速上展现出高效性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Weight-space networks operate directly on parameters of other neural networks, enabling tasks such as predicting model properties, editing trained models, and generating weights. Weight-space symmetries such as neuron permutations make equivariance a key design principle. However, existing equivariant weight-space architectures have primarily been studied for transformations that preserve the network architecture. In contrast, many practical transformations, including model compression and upscaling, map a trained source network into a target network with a different architecture. In this setting, the source and target permutation symmetries act on different parameter spaces, making equivariance less straightforward to formulate. Our key idea for addressing this mismatch is to reformulate cross-architecture operators with two inputs: a trained source network and an initialization of the target network. This lets us define equivariant cross-architecture operators that refine the initialization of the target network using information from the source network, while being invariant to source-network permutations and equivariant to target-network permutations. Based on this formulation, we introduce CrossGMN, a graph metanetwork that jointly processes both networks through symmetry-preserving cross-network message passing. We prove CrossGMN is universal for continuous cross-architecture operators on compact sets under a general-position assumption. We evaluate CrossGMN for model compression, predicting a smaller network's parameters to accelerate subsequent knowledge distillation. Across 2-D and 3-D INRs and image classification with MLPs, CNNs, and Vision Transformers, CrossGMN speeds up distillation by up to 8.89x, transfers across datasets without retraining (3.78x), and a single model can accelerate compression from heterogeneous source architectures into a common target architecture.

</details>


### [234] [Iterative Policy Refinement through Semantic Rollout Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01652)
*Feiyu Gavin Zhu,Qi Xu,Zhifei Deng,Zhigang Hua,Luke Simon,Jean Oh,Reid Simmons*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出闭环框架，通过LLM分析策略rollout的表格化日志，迭代修正结构化策略，无需人工指令，在赛车和开门任务上提升模仿学习性能并降低计算需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化策略通过引入任务特定的归纳偏置，能提升模仿学习的效率、鲁棒性和可解释性；但现有结构生成方法依赖大量人工输入或LLM中的静态领域知识，可能与专家示范不一致。

Method: 提出闭环框架，利用LLM引导的rollout分析迭代精炼结构化策略：将rollout记录为语义上有意义的表格数据，提示LLM生成诊断分析代码，从而识别策略结构中的次优之处并迭代修正，无需人工指令。

Result: 在赛车和开门任务上，方法相比零样本LLM生成结构将模仿学习性能提升最高15%，达到相同强化学习性能所需计算量减少75%。

Conclusion: 表格化rollout分析提供了有效的反馈信号，使LLM生成的结构与专家示范对齐，可自动生成良好的策略结构。

Abstract: Structured policies improve efficiency, robustness, and interpretability in imitation learning by introducing task-specific inductive bias, but existing structure generation methods rely either on extensive human input or on static domain knowledge encoded in LLMs, which may be inconsistent with the expert demonstrations. We propose a closed-loop framework that iteratively refines structured policies using LLM-guided analysis of policy rollouts. By logging rollouts as semantically meaningful tabular data and prompting the LLM to generate diagnostic analysis code, our method identifies suboptimalities in the policy structure and iteratively corrects them without requiring human instruction. Experiments on car racing and door opening tasks show that our approach improves imitation learning performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM-generated structures and requires 75% less compute to achieve the same reinforcement learning performance. These results demonstrate that tabular rollout analysis provides an effective feedback signal to align LLM-generated policy structures with expert demonstrations, and we can utilize it to generate good policy structures automatically.

</details>


### [235] [pCoMole: Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing with Discrete Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01663)
*Tong Chen,Maximilian Holsman,Lin Zhao,Pranam Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: pCoMole：基于离散流匹配的帕累托约束分子编辑框架，实现多目标优化、硬约束可行性与序列编辑的统一，并在GFP缩短、Cas9压缩、肽模拟物设计中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物分子治疗药物常需从已知序列出发进行定点编辑，以同时优化多种性质并满足生物化学与可制造性硬约束；但现有生成方法无法在离散、变长生物序列空间中同时支持多目标优化、硬可行性与序列编辑。

Method: 提出Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing (pCoMole)，构建于离散流匹配之上，引导预训练Edit Flow朝用户偏好方向演化并强制终止可行性。采用增强Tchebycheff效用定义可行性门控的终止分布，通过Doob h-变换实现偏好倾斜，并用短Monte Carlo rollout近似所需调和函数，得到高效且具偏好一致性的引导编辑器。

Result: 在缩短GFP并保留荧光相关性质、压缩多种Cas9同源物并保持PAM特异性、将肽结合物压缩为在硬约束下优化七种药物相关性质的短肽模拟物上完成验证；湿实验中，两个229残基的pCoMole设计eGFP变体在BL21细胞中经10处缺失及1或2处替换后仍保持明显绿色荧光。

Conclusion: pCoMole实现了离散、变长空间中约束感知且帕累托对齐的生物分子序列编辑。

Abstract: Biomolecular therapeutics often start from known sequences and require targeted editing to improve multiple properties while satisfying hard biochemical and manufacturability constraints. However, existing generative methods do not jointly support multi-objective optimization, hard feasibility, and sequence editing in discrete, variable-length biological spaces. In this work, we introduce Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing (pCoMole), a framework built on discrete flow matching that steers a pre-trained Edit Flow toward user-specified preferences while enforcing terminal feasibility. pCoMole defines a feasibility-gated terminal distribution using an augmented Tchebycheff utility and realizes the resulting preference tilt through a Doob-h transform of the underlying edit process. To make this construction practical, we approximate the required harmonic function using short Monte Carlo rollouts over candidate edits, yielding an efficient guided editor with provable preference consistency. We validate pCoMole by shrinking GFP while retaining fluorescence-related properties, shortening diverse Cas9 orthologs while preserving PAM specificity, and compressing peptide binders into short peptidomimetics that optimize seven drug-related properties under hard constraints. In wet lab testing, two 229-residue pCoMole-designed eGFP variants retained clear green fluorescence in BL21 cells after 10 deletions, with either one or two substitutions. Together, pCoMole enables constraint-aware, Pareto-aligned editing of biomolecular sequences in discrete, variable-length spaces.

</details>


### [236] [Invent a Dataset: Measuring dataset generation abilities with zero seed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01674)
*Shivalika Singh,Andrija Djurisic,Gbemileke Onilude,Sudip Roy,Sara Hooker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Invent-A-Dataset，一种基于提示的系统，可在零数据（zero data regime）条件下，从数据集描述直接生成真实、大规模的后训练数据集。在八类任务、最高 20K 样本规模下，该方法相较五家前沿模型 API 在质量上取得 17% 相对提升，多样性取得 19% 相对提升，并带来更优的下游后训练模型表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集构建仍是 AI 开发中最依赖人工、最脆弱的环节之一。作者聚焦于实践中常见却极端的零数据场景：开发者对目标能力完全没有可用数据，因此需要一种能自动化生成高质量、大规模数据集的方案。

Method: 提出 Invent-A-Dataset，一个基于提示（prompt based）的系统，输入为数据集描述，输出为真实且大规模的后训练数据集。将其与 Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Zai 五家前沿模型 API 在八类任务、最高 20K 样本规模上进行对比评估。

Result: Invent-A-Dataset 显著优于对比基线：质量取得 17% 相对增益，多样性取得 19% 相对增益；且多样性优势随训练数据规模扩大而增强（200 样本时持平，20K 样本时相对增益达 37%）。这种优势转化为可观的下游训练收益，产生性能更强的后训练模型，且在不同后训练模型架构上其微调结果排名均更靠前。

Conclusion: Invent-A-Dataset 能有效解决零数据场景下的数据集构建难题，在质量、多样性及下游训练效果上均优于现有前沿模型 API 方案，且其多样性优势具备良好的规模可扩展性，为自动化数据集生成提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Building datasets remains one of the most manual and brittle parts of AI development. In this technical report, we focus on the most extreme but also most prevalent setting real world practitioners face: a zero data regime. Here, practitioners don't have any data for the capability they want to learn. We introduce Invent-A-Dataset which is a prompt based system to go from dataset description to realistic and large scale post-training datasets. We evaluate Invent-A-Dataset against five frontier model APIs including Anthropic, Google, Open AI, DeepSeek, Zai. Across eight task types and dataset sizes up to 20K samples, Invent-A-Dataset significantly outperforms with both the highest quality (17% relative gains) while simultaneously producing the most diverse samples (19% relative gains). Its diversity advantage widens with scale of training dataset size (from parity at 200 samples to 37% relative gains at 20K samples). This translates into considerable downstream training gains, resulting in far more performant post-trained models. Invent-A-Dataset fine-tune consistently ranks higher compared to other generator fine-tunes across different post-trained model architectures.

</details>


### [237] [MiLoop: Selective Memory Propagation for Neural Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01685)
*Changliang Zhou,Yuanyao Chen,Rongsheng Chen,Zhiyun Lin,Zhenkun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MiLoop是一个纯强化学习的构造式神经组合优化框架，利用单次rollout中已有多步计算进行选择性记忆传播，使浅层策略无需外部标签或训练期搜索空间剪枝即可学习有效动态嵌入，在四类组合优化问题、100至1000万节点规模上稳定获得高质量解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构造式神经组合优化虽能减少手工规则依赖并实现快速推理，但现有动态嵌入方法通常在每个决策步用深层注意力堆栈从零重建子问题表示，计算冗余；同时高性能方法多依赖解标签/伪标签训练，或在强化学习中激进剪枝搜索空间，限制了通用性与可扩展性。

Method: 提出Memory-in-the-Loop (MiLoop)框架：复用一次rollout中本就需要的多步计算，将历史表示沿轨迹传播，形成学习信号与记忆传递的循环。具体地，在注意力层之前将当前嵌入与历史记忆融合，在注意力层之后施加自适应门控更新；更新后的表示同时服务于当前决策与后续步骤复用，从而以浅层策略实现动态嵌入，无需外部解标签与训练期搜索空间剪枝。

Result: 在四类组合优化问题上的大量实验表明，MiLoop在100至1000万节点规模的实例上持续生成高质量解，展现出很强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: MiLoop以纯强化学习方式结合记忆机制，避免了对标签和搜索空间剪枝的依赖，验证了利用rollout内多步计算进行选择性记忆传播的有效性，为构造式NCO提供了兼顾泛化性与大规模可扩展性的方案。

Abstract: Constructive neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has emerged as a promising paradigm that learns to construct solutions to combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) step by step, which reduces reliance on handcrafted rules and enables fast inference. While many methods with dynamic embeddings generalize well, they typically rebuild subproblem representations from scratch at each step using deep attention stacks. Many high-performing methods in this category rely on solution labels or pseudo-labels for efficient training, or on aggressive search space pruning during reinforcement learning (RL). To address these limitations, we propose Memory-in-the-Loop (MiLoop), a purely RL-based constructive framework that leverages the multi-step computation already required by a rollout for selective memory propagation. Each rollout provides solution-quality feedback for learning while propagating historical representations, thereby enabling a shallow policy to learn effective dynamic embeddings without external solution labels or training-time search-space pruning. Specifically, MiLoop fuses current embeddings with historical memory before the attention layers and applies adaptive gated updates afterward. The updated representations support both current decisions and stepwise reuse. Extensive experiments across four COPs demonstrate that MiLoop consistently produces high-quality solutions on instances ranging from 100 to 10 million nodes, highlighting its strong generalization ability.

</details>


### [238] [Artifact Annotations Partially Substitute for Per-User Calibration: SAFE-EDA and a Normalization-Controlled Evaluation of Wrist-EDA Affect Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01692)
*Haochen Chai,Xinbi Luo,Zining Liu,Fangfang Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 腕部皮肤电活动的归一化统计量来源会显著改变预训练效果的评估：使用被试自身整段记录统计时，预训练增益大幅缩水甚至不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有情感识别模型在被试独立测试（held-out subject）时很少报告归一化统计量的来源；若统计量来自被测试者自己的录音，模型会获得设备首次佩戴时尚不具备的信息，从而高估预训练收益，需厘清这一选择对结论的影响。

Method: 以紧凑卷积网络 SAFE-EDA 为对象，先在 43 名被试的专家伪迹标注上预训练，再在 WESAD 数据集（15 人，留一被试法）从头训练作对比；交叉两种归一化来源（仅训练被试统计 / 被留出者整段录音统计）与四种窗口步长；并比较伪迹监督与自监督预训练，扩展到第二个数据集（26 人）共 13 种配置。

Result: 统计量仅来自训练被试时，预训练使 macro-F1 提升 0.078–0.227；来自被留出用户整段录音时，增益降至 0.020–0.050 且不再显著。伪迹监督（0.078）远优于同批录音的自监督预训练（0.008）。13 种配置中预训练网络在 12 种更优，但在第二个数据集上按用户归一化反而增大增益，说明该交互依赖数据。

Conclusion: 预训练收益的测量高度依赖归一化统计量来源，须区分"首次佩戴性能"与"校准后性能"；50 篇已发表 WESAD 研究中仅 5 篇报告了归一化所用数据，报告该选择是必要的。

Abstract: Wrist electrodermal activity (EDA) differs in amplitude from one person to the next, so affect-recognition models normalize their input before classification. Studies that test such models on held-out subjects seldom report where the normalization statistics come from, yet statistics computed from the held-out subject's own recording give the model information that a device does not have when it is first worn. We asked how this choice alters the measured benefit of pretraining. A compact convolutional network, SAFE-EDA, was pretrained on expert artifact annotations from 43 subjects and compared with the same network trained from scratch on the Wearable Stress and Affect Detection (WESAD) dataset (15 subjects, leave-one-subject-out), with two normalization sources crossed with four window hops. When the statistics came only from training subjects, pretraining raised macro-F1 by 0.078 to 0.227; when they came from the held-out user's full recording, the gain fell to between 0.020 and 0.050 and was no longer significant. Artifact supervision was far more useful than self-supervised pretraining on the same recordings (0.078 versus 0.008). Across 13 configurations in two datasets, the pretrained network was better in 12, but on the second dataset (26 subjects) per-user normalization increased the gain instead of reducing it, so the interaction depends on the data. Only five of 50 published WESAD studies state which data were used for normalization. Reporting this choice is necessary to separate first-use performance from performance after calibration.

</details>


### [239] [Learning PDE Dynamics between Submanifolds Using Green's Observation Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01697)
*Jan Tauberschmidt,Jephte Abijuru,Samuel Okon,Naukshatro Bose,Sophie Fellenz,Marius Kloft,Jonas Latz,Sebastian Josef Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Green's Observation Operator (GObO)，将环境介质一次性映射为限制在源与观测子流形上的线性PDE格林核，使新源只需低维积分且无需网络评估；在3D热传导与对流-扩散任务上，对移动源零样本预测误差比黑盒代理低4–8倍，单次条件化后查询耗时1.4 ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多物理系统仅在更大空间域的低维子流形上被驱动和观测（如红外相机成像的激光加热区域、传感器平面测得的地面排放），而动力学由充满该域的环境介质决定。全域求解器对每个新源都要计算整个体积，但实际只需观测子流形；黑盒代理则未利用环境介质固定不变这一先验，导致效率与精度不足。

Method: 提出Green's Observation Operator (GObO)：对固定环境介质只做一次映射，得到线性PDE格林核并限制到源子流形与观测子流形；新源响应通过一次低维积分获得，无需网络前向。利用核的指数衰减特性构造精确有限流式状态，实现与时间视界无关的常数内存；理论上证明了该状态的稳定性，并给出受限热核的近似率。可迁移至不同分辨率，并支持对轻度非线性（辐射损失、温度依赖导热率）的免重训练修正。

Result: 在三维热传导与对流-扩散问题上，涵盖源与观测共置及分离两种几何：GObO仅在静态源上训练即可零样本预测移动源的响应，误差比黑盒代理低4–8倍，单次条件化后每次查询仅1.4 ms。同一核可跨分辨率迁移，并可在不重训练的情况下修正轻度非线性（辐射损失、温度依赖导热率），代价是分布内精度有所下降。

Conclusion: GObO通过将固定环境介质预计算为受限格林核，把新源查询降为低维积分，兼具零样本泛化、常数内存、快速查询与跨分辨率迁移能力，并可扩展到轻度非线性情形，为低维观测下的物理场高效预测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Many physical systems are driven and observed only on lower-dimensional submanifolds of a larger spatial domain, while their dynamics are governed by the ambient medium occupying that domain. Examples include laser-heated parts imaged by an infrared camera, and ground-level emissions measured on a sensor plane. Full-domain solvers, however, compute the entire volume for every new source although only the observation submanifold is needed, and black-box surrogates do not exploit that the ambient medium remains fixed. We introduce the \emph{Green's Observation Operator (GObO)}, which maps the ambient medium once to the Green's kernel of a linear PDE restricted to the source and observation submanifolds. New sources then cost one lower-dimensional integral and no network evaluation. Exponential rates in the kernel yield an exact finite streaming state with horizon-independent memory; we prove its stability and an approximation rate for the restricted heat kernel. On three-dimensional heat conduction and advection--diffusion with collocated and distinct source and observation geometries, GObO trained on static sources predicts responses to moving sources zero-shot with 4--8$\times$ lower error than black-box surrogates, at 1.4\,ms per query after a single conditioning pass. The same kernel transfers across resolutions and admits corrections for mild nonlinearities, including radiative losses and temperature-dependent conductivity, without retraining, at the cost of lower in-distribution accuracy.

</details>


### [240] [In-context Learning of Single-index Targets: Comparing Kernel and Feature Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01712)
*Haotian Gu,Yizhou Xu,Lenka Zdeborová*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过复本方法比较两种单层注意力架构（核学习器与特征学习器）在单指标非线性任务上的记忆与泛化误差，给出与实验吻合的相图及上下文长度标度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文学习（ICL）理论多局限于线性目标函数，对非线性任务的架构差异与数据规模交互缺乏刻画，作者希望厘清架构选择如何随预训练数据量、任务多样性与上下文长度影响非线性ICL。

Method: 在同一单指标任务族上对比两种单层注意力架构：核学习器先用固定非线性特征映射再施加线性注意力；特征学习器直接对原始输入做注意力并接可学习非线性读出。采用复本方法推导二者的记忆与泛化误差预测，保留预训练规模、任务池多样性以及训练/推理上下文长度的影响，并与数值实验对照。

Result: 理论预测在广泛区间内与数值实验高度吻合；得到刻画两种架构优劣随预训练数据量、任务多样性与上下文长度变化的相图；并识别出两者在上下文长度标度上的定性差异。

Conclusion: 架构选择与数据集（规模、多样性、上下文长度）存在显著交互作用，二者共同决定非线性ICL的表现；核学习器与特征学习器在不同区间各有优势，且上下文长度标度行为本质不同。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables a pretrained model to infer a task from demonstrations without updating its parameters. While much of the existing theory focuses on linear target functions, in this paper we study nonlinear cases by comparing two one-layer attention architectures on the same family of single-index tasks. A kernel learner first maps inputs through a fixed nonlinear feature map and then applies linear attention, whereas a feature learner applies attention to the original input, followed by a learned nonlinear readout. We derive predictions for their memorization and generalization errors using the replica method, retaining the effects of pretraining size, task-pool diversity, and training and inference context lengths. The resulting predictions closely match numerical experiments across a broad range of regimes. Our analysis yields phase diagrams that characterize when each architecture is advantageous as the amount of pretraining data, task diversity, and context lengths vary. We further identify qualitatively different context-length scalings for the two learners. Together, these results clarify how architectural choices interact with the dataset and govern nonlinear in-context learning.

</details>


### [241] [Anomaly Detection and Localization for the Pantograph-Catenary System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01721)
*Francesco Vitale,Hangli Ge,Francesco Flammini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个结合GPS路线对齐定位与集体异常检测的框架，用于监测弓网系统（PCS）健康状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业方案通过视频监控和卷积神经网络追踪接触线高度与拉出值，但未考虑列车所在的地理位置，难以评估特定路段的基础设施与弓网健康状态。

Method: 构建框架包含两步：1）将PCS高度/拉出值与参考线路的名义GPS坐标对齐以完成定位；2）采用集体异常检测评估PCS健康状态。基于铁路运输公司提供的真实工业数据集（含多条意大利铁路线路上多次列车旅程的PCS高度/拉出值）进行案例研究。

Result: 在真实工业数据集上应用并评估了该方法的定位与检测性能。

Conclusion: 该框架能够结合地理位置对PCS进行定位并进行集体异常检测，从而评估弓网系统健康状态。

Abstract: Monitoring the Pantograph-Catenary System (PCS) provides insight into the health conditions of the pantograph and the railway infrastructure. Recent industrial solutions trace the pantograph's contact wire height and stagger (PCS height/stagger) using video monitoring through convolutional neural networks. However, these solutions do not account for the train route's geographic location. Therefore, in this paper we propose a novel framework for 1) localization of the PCS height/stagger by alignment with the nominal GPS coordinates of the reference route, and 2) collective anomaly detection to evaluate the health conditions of the PCS. We apply and assess the localization and detection performance of the methodology to a case-study based on a real-world industrial dataset provided by a railway transportation company, which includes the PCS height/stagger of several train journeys across Italian railway routes.

</details>


### [242] [RelICL: Training-free Relational Learning with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01725)
*Simon Forbat,Rainer Gemulla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对关系学习中使用深度特征合成（DFS）结合表格基础模型存在的特征爆炸与交互盲区问题，提出RelICL方法，通过在同一表格基础模型上沿模式图逐步传播与融合信息，在RelBench任务上取得与最强DFS方法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型在单表任务上无需训练即可达到最优性能。近期工作表明，通过DFS将关系模式展平为单表（把其他表的列聚合作为特征）也适用于关系学习，且能直接受益于底层表格基础模型的改进与定制。然而DFS存在两个关键问题：一是特征爆炸——模式越复杂，DFS特征数量增长越快，限制了可扩展性与性能；二是交互盲区——按列聚合无法考虑特征之间的交互，从而限制性能。

Method: 提出RelICL方法：保留DFS的优点，同时缓解上述两个问题。其核心是在模式图上逐步传播并融合信息，并且使用最终用于预测的同一个表格基础模型来完成这一传播与融合过程。

Result: 在RelBench任务上开展实验研究，RelICL的表现与基于深度特征合成的最强方法相当（on par）。

Conclusion: RelICL通过沿模式图逐步传播与融合信息的方式，在保留DFS优势的同时缓解了特征爆炸与交互盲区问题，可在关系学习任务上达到与最强DFS方法相当的性能。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models achieve state-of-the-art performance on single-table tasks without any training. Recent work suggests that they are also well-suited for relational learning via deep feature synthesis (DFS), which flattens a relational schema into a single table by adding aggregates of the other tables' columns as features. This approach is appealing because it directly benefits from improvements to or customization of the underlying tabular foundation model. In this paper, we identify two key problems with DFS: feature explosion and interaction blindness. The first problem arises because the number of DFS features grows quickly as the schema becomes more complex, limiting scalability and performance. The second problem arises because column-wise aggregates do not account for feature interactions, limiting performance. We propose and explore an alternative method termed RelICL, which keeps the benefits of DFS but alleviates these two problems. At its heart, RelICL propagates and fuses information step by step through the schema graph, using the same tabular foundation model that is eventually used for prediction to do so. In our experimental study using RelBench tasks, RelICL was on par with the strongest approach based on deep feature synthesis.

</details>


### [243] [Removing spurious minima for planar features by skip connections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01728)
*Jakob Paul Zimmermann,Moritz Grillo,Andrei Balakin,Georg Loho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究无偏置浅层ReLU网络在高斯总体损失下的损失景观，刻画了可学习线性跳跃连接对虚假局部极小值的消除作用及过参数化的有效宽度限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解损失景观对解释神经网络训练至关重要，但即便在简单模型中其结构也仅被部分理解；作者希望借助教师-学生框架下的无偏置浅层ReLU网络，研究特征学习与过参数化等核心问题。

Method: 分析无偏置浅层ReLU网络在教师-学生设定下的高斯总体损失；考虑具有正输出权重和平面特征的教师网络，比较含与不含可学习线性跳跃连接的情形，并研究局部极小处学生特征方向与教师特征张成子空间的关系。

Result: 当学生网络宽度不小于教师网络时，加入可学习线性跳跃连接可消除所有具有非负学生输出权重的虚假局部极小值；而无跳跃连接时，作者构造出输入维度为2、仅含3个隐藏神经元的固定教师网络，其虚假局部极小值在任意学生宽度（≥3）下都持续存在。此外，正输出权重学生网络的局部极小处特征位于教师特征张成空间中；二维ReLU网络中，任何正输出权重临界点的不同学生特征方向数至多两倍于教师神经元数。最后将良性结果推广到任意半径参数球上的经验极小值，采样精度依赖该半径。

Conclusion: 可学习线性跳跃连接能够消除在任意过参数化下仍持续存在的虚假极小值；过参数化学生网络的有效宽度受教师宽度控制，且良性景观性质可迁移至经验损失极小值。

Abstract: Understanding loss landscapes is central to explaining neural-network training, yet their structure remains only partially understood even in simple models. We study the Gaussian population loss of shallow, bias-free ReLU networks in the teacher--student setting. This provides a simple model for studying essential aspects such as feature learning and overparameterization. For teacher networks with positive output weights and planar features, we show that including a learned linear skip removes all spurious local minima with non-negative student output weights once the student network is at least as wide as the teacher network. In contrast, without the skip, we construct a fixed teacher network with positive output weights and only three hidden neurons in input dimension two whose spurious local minima persist at every student width at least three. Thus, a learned linear skip can remove spurious minima that persist under arbitrary overparameterization. Furthermore, we show that a positive output weight student network always learns the subspace spanned by the teacher features: student features at local minima with non-negative student output weights lie in the span of the teacher features. For ReLU networks in two dimensions, even heavily overparameterized student networks have effective width controlled by the teacher width: every critical point with positive student output weights has at most twice as many distinct student feature directions as teacher neurons. Finally, we transfer the benignity result to empirical minima over parameter balls of any prescribed radius, with the required sampling accuracy depending on that radius.

</details>


### [244] [Function-Structured Reinforcement Learning with Executable Verifiers for Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01729)
*Zihan Liu,Xurong Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FSG-RL框架，将子问题图、代码实现与多验证器反馈结合，通过SFT+GRPO提升数学推理的可靠分解与计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法数学推理需要可靠的分解、计算与聚合。仅依赖最终答案的奖励对中间错误指导有限，且程序成功执行并不保证数学正确性。因此需要更细粒度的结构化监督与验证反馈。

Method: FSG-RL连接子问题图与Python实现，并引入多验证器反馈。策略先经SFT学习从函数图生成代码；再用GRPO结合答案门控奖励与span级信用分配进行优化；同时支持教师监督与结构化记忆。基准数据取自GSM8K、MathQA、MATH、Omni-MATH，配对公开函数图与私有验证规范。

Result: 在统一评测协议下，GRPO将最终答案准确率从43.25%提升至67.50%，完整解题成功率从32.25%提升至52.25%（相较SFT）；继续以教师监督进行RL可带来额外增益。

Conclusion: 性能提升不仅源于生成格式正确的代码，表明验证器引导的强化学习能有效促进数学推理。代码已开源。

Abstract: Algorithmic mathematical reasoning requires reliable decomposition, computation, and aggregation. Final-answer rewards provide limited guidance on intermediate errors, while successful execution does not guarantee mathematical correctness. This work proposes Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning (FSG-RL), connecting subproblem graphs and Python implementations with multi-verifier feedback. The policy first learns to generate code from function graphs through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) then optimizes the policy using answer-gated rewards and span-level credit assignment. The framework also supports teacher supervision and structured memory. A benchmark curated from Grade School Math 8K (GSM8K), MathQA, MATH, and Omni-MATH pairs public function graphs with private verification specifications. Under a unified evaluation protocol, GRPO improves final-answer accuracy from 43.25% to 67.50% and full solution success from 32.25% to 52.25% over SFT. Continued reinforcement learning (RL) with teacher supervision yields additional gains. The gains extend beyond producing correctly formatted code, supporting verifier-guided reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/ZihanLiummyycc/FSG-RL.

</details>


### [245] [Fixed-point neural samplers on discrete spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01739)
*Jiajun He,Denis Blessing,Mouyang Cheng,Yuanqi Du,Carles Domingo-Enrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出离散吉布斯迭代神经采样器（Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler），一种基于不动点迭代的离散神经采样框架，缓解模式崩塌、提供收敛保证并扩展至分布间传输，可高效扩展至高维系统并用于合金相图估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从离散、未归一化分布中采样且无法访问数据是困难问题。现有离散神经采样器存在三方面不足：(1) 易发生模式崩塌（mode collapse）；(2) 以不动点迭代训练时缺乏收敛保证；(3) 往往绑定于特定参考过程，如掩码扩散或均匀扩散，缺乏通用性。因此需要一个兼顾学习效率、可扩展性与收敛性的通用离散采样框架。

Method: 提出离散吉布斯迭代神经采样器：一种不动点（fixed-point）神经采样器。框架建立在掩码扩散（masked diffusion）之上，并进一步扩展到一对分布之间的传输（transport）。通过迭代不动点方式训练生成模型，直接从密度评估学习，无需数据样本。

Result: 实验表明该方法在实践中有助于大幅减少模式崩塌，可有效扩展至高维系统，支持跨不同条件的摊销采样（amortized sampling），并能实现合金相图的准确估计。

Conclusion: 该工作为离散未归一化分布采样提供了一种兼具可扩展性、收敛性与通用性的不动点神经采样方案，并在高维系统与材料相图估计等任务上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Sampling from discrete, unnormalized distributions without access to data is a challenging problem. Neural samplers offer a promising approach by training generative models from density evaluations directly. Despite recent progress, existing discrete neural samplers are prone to mode collapse, come without convergence guarantees when trained via fixed-point iterations, and are often tied to a specific reference process such as masked or uniform diffusion. In this work, we introduce Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler, a fixed-point neural sampler that addresses these limitations, enabling efficient, scalable learning, substantially reducing mode collapse in practice. Our framework builds on masked diffusion and also extends to transport between pairs of distributions. We demonstrate that the resulting method scales effectively to high-dimensional systems, supports amortized sampling across different conditions, and enables accurate estimation of alloy phase diagrams.

</details>


### [246] [Evidence-Gated Research: Statistically Controlled Model Adoption in Adaptive Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01751)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Evidence-Gated Research（EGR），一种面向"移动在位者"式自适应模型搜索的统计采纳层，通过对冻结挑战者构建 anytime-valid 证据并在显式条件下控制 FDR，实现了对路径依赖式替换的统计把关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应模型搜索具有路径依赖性：一旦某个挑战者被采纳，它就成为后续候选生成的参照基准，因此统计上缺乏依据的替换会改变尚未被提出的假设。作者据此指出模型替换是自适应模型开发中一个独立且此前被忽视的统计控制点。

Method: EGR 在决策证据揭示前冻结每个挑战者；在预先声明的环境集合上构建 anytime-valid 证据；将证据可预测地路由至尚未解决的组件；组合出持续的候选 e-value，并交给在线控制器（如 e-LOND）。在给定条件有效性（conditional validity）与可预测性（predictability）条件下证明该过程控制全环境采纳目标的 FDR。

Result: 5,000 条轨迹的闭环基准中，纯开发集 e-LOND 的持续 FDR 达 0.621，而所审计的 EGR 变体在该有限运行中未观察到持续误采纳路径；600 对挑战者—在位者匹配重放中，Stagewise EGR 在保持固定 anytime 备择跨越决策的同时将代表性阈值处的决策证据用量降低 56.1%；三环境公开数据研究与 40,000 样本受控神经基准复现了证据效率模式。

Conclusion: 模型替换应被视为自适应模型开发中独立的统计控制点，EGR 在路径依赖搜索下兼顾 FDR 控制与证据效率。

Abstract: Adaptive model search is path dependent: once a challenger is adopted, it becomes the reference from which later candidates are generated. A statistically unsupported replacement can therefore alter hypotheses that have not yet been proposed. We introduce Evidence-Gated Research (EGR), a statistical adoption layer for moving-incumbent search. EGR freezes each challenger before decision evidence is revealed, builds anytime-valid evidence across a predeclared set of environments, routes evidence predictably toward unresolved components, composes a persistent candidate e-value, and passes that e-value to an online controller. Under explicit conditional-validity and predictability conditions, the resulting procedure controls false discovery rate for the declared all-environment adoption target even though earlier adoptions change later challengers. In a 5,000-trajectory closed-loop benchmark, development-only e-LOND attains persistent FDR 0.621, whereas no persistent false-adoption path is observed for the audited EGR variants in that finite run. In matched replay over 600 challenger--incumbent pairs, Stagewise EGR preserves fixed-anytime alternative crossing decisions while using 56.1% less decision evidence at the representative threshold. A three-environment public-data study and a 40,000-sample controlled neural benchmark reproduce the evidence-efficiency pattern. These results identify model replacement as a distinct statistical control point in adaptive model development.

</details>


### [247] [Physics-Refined Spatiotemporal Forecasting on Open-Boundary Hydrologic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01765)
*Haoyang Jiang,Zhengui Wang,Shenghan Gao,Y. Joseph Zhang,Xingquan Zhu,Yi He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对开边界水文图时空预报的外部强迫缺失与自回归误差累积问题，提出含"幽灵节点代理学习"与"双层物理精炼器"的计算框架，在真实水文图上实现更高精度与长期稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水文图上的时空预报在开边界系统中尤其不稳定：预报域与未观测的外部之间存在通量交换。边界节点受外部强迫驱动（如河流上游入流、海岸带潮汐信号），而这些信息在预测时刻通常不可获得。信息缺失会在自回归展开中不断放大误差，导致长期预报性能显著下降。因此，需要厘清两个问题：1）当边界外信息缺失时，进入预报域的边界强迫是什么；2）该强迫应如何在域内传播而不引发自回归展开下的误差放大。

Method: 框架包含两个关键组件。其一，为补偿边界强迫，从边界节点与内部节点学习"幽灵节点代理"（ghost node proxies），近似未观测的外部输入。其二，为控制由所学代理带来的误差累积，引入两个物理精炼器（physics refiners）：一个通过将幽灵代理与其二跳邻居（即边界节点及其直接内部节点）对齐，施加局部一致性约束；另一个借助物理引导的图神经算子（physics-guided graph neural operator）修正模型预报，提升全局稳定性并抑制长期数值漂移。

Result: 在两个真实水文图上进行实证评估，与基于学习的模型及物理信息（physics-informed）模型竞争者相比，该方案在预测精度和长期稳定性两方面均取得更优表现。

Conclusion: 该工作将开边界水文图预报的不稳定性拆解为"边界强迫估计"与"强迫传播中的误差控制"两个子问题，并通过幽灵节点代理与双重物理精炼机制加以解决，验证了物理约束与图神经算子结合在长时程水文预报中的有效性。

Abstract: Spatiotemporal forecasting on hydrologic graphs is especially prone to instability in open-boundary systems, where the forecast domain exchanges fluxes with an unobserved exterior. In such systems, boundary nodes receive external forcing, e.g., upstream inflows in rivers or tidal signals in coastal regions, that is typically unavailable at prediction time. The absence of this information can compound errors as forecasts unfold in an autoregressive fashion, leading to inferior long-horizon performance. This paper dissects this instability issue by exploring two questions. 1) What boundary forcing enters the forecast domain when information beyond the boundary is missing? 2) How should this forcing propagate through the domain without incurring error amplification under autoregressive rollout?
  To address both, we propose a new computing framework comprising two key components. First, to compensate for the boundary forcing, our framework learns ghost node proxies from the boundary and interior nodes, striving to approximate unobserved external inputs. Second, to control error accumulation from these learned proxies, we leverage two physics refiners. In particular, one refiner enforces local consistency by aligning ghost proxies with their two-hop neighbors (i.e., boundary nodes and their immediate interiors). The other refiner enhances global stability by correcting the model forecasts through a physics-guided graph neural operator, reducing long-horizon numerical drift. Two real-world hydrologic graphs are employed for empirical evaluation. Comparative results show that our proposal enjoys higher prediction accuracy and long-horizon stability over both learning-based and physics-informed model competitors.

</details>


### [248] [iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01789)
*Ashok Prasad Neupane,Saugat Adhikari,Pramish Paudel,Ajad Chhatkuli,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论与方法两方面改进扩散模型的强化学习后训练，证明仅更新后期时间步会损害多样性，并提出基于Feynman-Kac的增量训练方法，实现更优的对齐-多样性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的扩散模型后训练（如DDPO）在优化奖励时牺牲了生成样本的多样性和质量，需要更优的权衡。

Method: 通过理论分析扩散模型框架，数学证明仅对后期时间步进行更新可能损害多样性（与前人结论相悖）；提出具有坚实理论基础的增量Feynman-Kac训练方法。

Result: 在三个不同任务上与相关扩散策略优化方法对比，并对各组件进行充分消融实验，验证在对齐与多样性两方面均取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 所提方法在理论上澄清了时间步更新对多样性的影响，并在实验中实现了目前最优的对齐-多样性权衡。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function. However, current approaches to reward optimizations do so at the cost of diversity and quality. In this paper, we provide better tradeoffs through careful theoretical considerations and method design. We analyze the theoretical framework and mathematically demonstrate that \emph{only-latter timestep} updates of diffusion model may be harmful for diversity contrary to the conclusions presented in a previous work. Additionally, we propose an incremental Feynman-Kac training based on strong theoretical foundations in order to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs. We perform extensive experiments and compare our method against related diffusion policy optimization approaches in three different tasks and also provide strong ablations for each component, thus validating strong performance gains in both alignment and diversity.

</details>


### [249] [Inferring Multi-Timescale Neural Dynamics with Switching Linear Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01786)
*Lulu Gong,Yongxu Zhang,Shreya Saxena*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出多时间尺度切换线性动力系统（MTS-SLDS），通过多滞后矩初始化与机制条件化 Laplace-EM 推断，从高维神经放电数据中识别随行为/任务状态变化的机制特异性潜在时间尺度，并可直接由潜在转移矩阵特征值提取特征时间尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经活动常呈现多个随行为状态和任务条件变化的时间尺度。识别这些时间尺度对理解神经计算与功能至关重要，但传统基于自相关拟合的方法难以扩展到高维群体记录，且当神经动力学随行为变化时可靠性下降；标准状态空间模型虽能建模高维群体活动，却未显式考虑多时间尺度，无法保证准确恢复潜在时间结构。

Method: 提出 MTS-SLDS 框架，用于从连续观测或脉冲神经观测中识别机制特异性潜在时间尺度。方法结合：(1) 多滞后矩初始化，跨多个观测滞后捕获时间结构；(2) 机制条件化（regime-conditioned）Laplace-EM 推断，减少不确定机制下动态统计的混叠。随后从学习到的潜在转移矩阵特征值直接提取特征时间尺度。

Result: 在高斯观测与泊松脉冲观测的合成实验和真实神经实验中，MTS-SLDS 在多个数据集上均能准确恢复时间尺度及切换结构。

Conclusion: MTS-SLDS 为从高维神经群体记录中识别机制相关多时间尺度提供了可行且准确的框架，克服了自相关拟合的可扩展性与鲁棒性限制，并弥补了标准状态空间模型对多时间尺度建模的不足。

Abstract: Neural activity often exhibits multiple timescales that can vary with behavioral states and task conditions. Identifying these timescales from neural recordings is important for better understanding neural computation and function. However, traditional approaches based on autocorrelation fitting are difficult to scale to high-dimensional population recordings and can become unreliable when neural dynamics change with behavior. State-space models have been a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional neural population activity through latent dynamical systems, but standard formulations and inference methods do not explicitly account for multiple timescales and therefore do not guarantee accurate recovery of the underlying temporal structure. Motivated by these questions, we introduce the Multi-Timescale Switching Linear Dynamical System (MTS-SLDS), a framework for identifying regime-specific latent timescales from continuous or spiking neural observations. MTS-SLDS combines a multi-lag moment initialization, which captures temporal structure across multiple observation lags, with \textit{regime-conditioned} Laplace-EM inference, which reduces mixing of dynamical statistics across uncertain regimes. Characteristic timescales can then be extracted directly from the eigenvalues of the learned latent transition matrices. In synthetic and neural experiments with Gaussian and Poisson spike observations, MTS-SLDS accurately recovers timescales and switching structure over multiple datasets.

</details>


### [250] [SAGE: Similarity-Based Cleaning of Poisoned Training Data from Verified Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01788)
*Chaeeun Han,Soodeh Atefi,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,Aron Laszka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出SAGE，仅依赖少量经专家验证的干净与投毒样本，通过非参数相似度加权预测检测训练集中的投毒样本，应对干净标签攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器学习依赖公开且不可信的数据源，数据投毒攻击（尤其是干净标签攻击，投毒样本与干净样本难以区分）威胁加剧。现有防御要么假设完全不知道哪些样本被投毒，要么需要大量经过验证的干净样本，而后者成本高、不切实际。因此需要一种只依赖少量验证样本的检测方案。

Method: 提出SAGE（Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion）。其核心是利用一个包含少量经取证专家验证为干净或被投毒样本的验证集，在一个单独数据集上训练通用特征提取器，再基于该验证集以非参数、相似度加权的方式进行预测，从而标记训练集中的投毒样本，避免因验证集过小导致的过拟合。

Result: 在标准基准上针对七种干净标签攻击方法进行评估，仅需少量验证过的投毒样本即可带来显著优势；此外发现验证干净样本在各类别的分布比验证样本数量更为重要。

Conclusion: 依赖少量经过验证的样本（含干净与投毒样本）即可有效检测干净标签投毒攻击，SAGE在多项基准上表现优异，且验证干净样本的类别分布是关键因素。

Abstract: As machine learning increasingly relies on public, untrusted data sources, data poisoning attacks, which inject malicious examples into training data to induce misclassification of a chosen target, pose a growing threat. Existing defenses either assume zero ground-truth information about which examples are poisoned, or they assume access to a large set of examples verified to be clean. Satisfying the latter assumption incurs significant cost since reliable verification can be very resource- or labor-intensive. This cost is particularly high for clean-label attacks, where poisoned examples are visually indistinguishable from clean data. Since requiring a large set of verified examples is impractical, we propose relying on a small set of verified examples including both clean and poisoned ones, i.e., each example verified either to be clean or poisoned through inspection by a forensic expert. The challenge is then to detect poisons based on a set of verified examples that is so small that most classification models would overfit. To address this challenge, we propose Similarity-based Approach for Ground-truth-driven Exclusion (SAGE), which trains a generic feature extractor on a separate dataset and then flags poisoned training examples using a non-parametric, similarity-weighted prediction based on the verified set. On standard benchmarks against seven clean-label attack methods, we demonstrate that having access to even a handful of verified poisoned examples provides a substantial advantage. We also find that the distribution of verified clean examples across classes matters more than the number of verified examples.

</details>


### [251] [Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01882)
*Zhuoran Li,Yunzhan Li,Xun Wang,Yihan Du,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OMAF，一种基于单步流模型（Flow Model）的在线多智能体强化学习框架，用Transformer流策略实现高表达力协调行为，并通过单步动作生成消除迭代采样开销，在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个任务上取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MARL策略学习需要兼顾对复杂多模态动作分布的高表达力建模与高效训练执行。生成式策略（尤其是扩散策略）能忠实刻画复杂多模态行为，但迭代采样代价高昂，限制了其在线多智能体场景的可扩展性。因此需要一个既具表达力又能高效生成动作的框架。

Method: OMAF采用基于Transformer的流策略来捕捉复杂协调行为；其近似路径得分代理（approximate path score surrogate）为同步流策略优化提供有原则的途径。为稳定且样本高效地学习，进一步设计联合优化方案，将softmax Q值估计与联合流策略目标耦合，实现协调策略学习。通过消除迭代采样，大幅降低训练开销而不牺牲策略表达力。

Result: 在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个标准任务上，OMAF持续取得更优性能，相比基线方法最高提升3.4倍回报，样本效率提升最高达10.5倍。

Conclusion: OMAF验证了单步流策略作为一种兼具表达力与计算效率的在线MARL范式的有效性，可在不牺牲策略表达力的前提下显著降低训练开销并提升性能与样本效率。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusionbased policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an Online MARL framework via one-step Flow model (OMAF) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. To enable stable and sampleefficient learning, we further develop a joint optimization scheme coupling softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective for coordinated policy learning. By eliminating iterative sampling, OMAF dramatically reduces training overhead without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo show that OMAF consistently achieves superior performance, with up to 3.4x higher returns and 10.5x sample efficiency improvement compared with baseline methods. These results validate the effectiveness of OMAF as an expressive and computationally efficient one-step flow policy paradigm for online MARL.

</details>


### [252] [Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01892)
*Feiyu Gavin Zhu,Xiaoyu Zhu,Jiqi Yang,Rui Yang,Arnab Kumar Mondal,Yancheng Wang,Xinke Deng,Jean Oh,Reid Simmons,Joerg Liebelt,Xiang Kong,Zhongyu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Selection-based Structured Reasoning（SSR），将多模态智能体的推理重构为"从预设候选推理中筛选"而非开放式生成，从而在2B/4B小模型上大幅降低推理延迟且不损失任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体通常在每次动作前生成自由形式的推理。小模型受限于容量，往往产生冗长却对动作生成帮助甚微的推理，既浪费推理开销又未提升效果。因此需要一种更高效、结构化的推理方式。

Method: SSR将反复出现的高层推理表示为预先设定的、可复用的自然语言候选。每一轮中，模型根据当前上下文下各候选的似然度进行选择，无需额外的辅助任务头。由于候选推理是预设的，可实现并行打分：利用共享上下文的KV cache，通过teacher-forced prefilling并发计算候选内部及候选之间的token似然。在七个多模态搜索基准上，用2B与4B模型结合多种强化学习目标及监督微调进行评估。

Result: 在多种RL目标与监督微调下，SSR显著提升效率且不损害任务性能。平均成功率与同规模领先搜索智能体相当，同时每轮推理延迟降低超过90%，每题总模型推理延迟降低28%–54%。

Conclusion: 将推理从开放式生成转为候选选择，是提升小模型多模态智能体推理效率的有效途径，在保持任务表现的同时大幅降低推理延迟。

Abstract: Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluate SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28-54%. Project page: https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/.

</details>


### [253] [SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01799)
*Kuo Zhou,ZiXion Yang,Lu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种突变增强的技能自演化框架，用于构建技能增强的Lean证明器，在多个基准上超越基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技能演化可在不更新参数的情况下提升大语言模型智能体，但在形式化定理证明中探索不足。现有方法主要针对自然语言推理，依赖成功与失败轨迹改进技能，但当所有采样轨迹均失败时缺乏成功轨迹以推断更新方向；且主要聚焦根指令文件，未充分探索数学概念与证明技巧等参考知识的演化。

Method: 提出突变增强的技能自演化框架，联合演化高层求解策略及其参考知识，通过渐进式与基于突变的更新实现。渐进式演化从成功与失败轨迹中提取局部改进；当无法生成完整证明时触发突变，采样数学概念以生成并选择新技能候选，并在验证器反馈下筛选。

Result: 在MiniF2F、PutnamBench、IMO 2025与USAMO 2026上评测。在相同骨干模型、轨迹采样预算和测试时计算量下，使用GPT-5.5取得证明成功率100.0%、90.6%、4/6、4/6，优于基线方法。概念引导突变在MiniF2F与PutnamBench上分别比随机文本引导突变高6.9与8.2个百分点，并在IMO 2025与USAMO 2026上各多解一题。

Conclusion: 该框架通过渐进式与突变式技能自演化，有效克服全失败轨迹下缺乏更新信号的瓶颈，并拓展参考知识的演化，显著提升形式化定理证明的性能。

Abstract: Skill evolution offers a promising way to improve large language model agents without updating their parameters, but its use in formal theorem proving remains underexplored. Existing methods mainly target natural-language reasoning, improving skills by analyzing successful and failed trajectories and incrementally revising solving strategies. Although the Lean verifier provides reliable execution feedback, when all sampled trajectories fail, existing skill evolution methods lack successful trajectories from which to infer effective update directions. Furthermore, these methods also focus mainly on the root instruction file, thus underexploring the evolution of reference knowledge including mathematical concepts and proving techniques. To address these limitations, we propose a mutation-enhanced skill self-evolution framework for building skill-augmented Lean provers. The framework jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge through progressive and mutation-based updates. Progressive evolution derives local improvements from successful and failed trajectories, while mutation is triggered when no complete proof can be generated, sampling mathematical concepts to produce and select new skill candidates under verifier feedback. We evaluate our method on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO 2025), and the 2026 USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO 2026). Under the same backbone model, trajectorysampling budget, and test-time compute, our method achieves proof success rates of 100.0%, 90.6%, 4/6, and 4/6, respectively, with GPT-5.5, outperforming the baseline methods. Further analysis shows that concept-guided mutation outperforms random-text-guided mutation by 6.9 and 8.2 percentage points on MiniF2F and PutnamBench, respectively, while solving one additional problem on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.

</details>


### [254] [Asynchronous LLM Post-Training: Group-Mass Capping and Convergence Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01896)
*Qijia He,Ruinan Jin,Jun Luo,Shaofeng Zou,Yingbin Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对异步强化学习中陈旧rollout导致的收敛性问题，提出收敛界分析并设计GMC-GRPO方法，将延迟项阈值依赖从O(ε⁻⁴)改进至O(ε⁻²)，实验验证其在大延迟下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步强化学习提升大语言模型后训练效率，但引入由早期策略生成的陈旧rollout。现有工作对陈旧性如何影响收敛、如何缓解其影响缺乏理论理解。

Method: 推导GRPO类算法的收敛界，刻画梯度估计器二阶矩与偏差的权衡；证明轨迹级重要性加权估计器中，二阶矩受控后延迟通过裁剪或重缩放的偏差进入界。据此提出组质量封顶GRPO（GMC-GRPO），在共享二阶矩保证的加权估计器类中最小化基于比值的偏差界。

Result: 建立异步GMC-GRPO的收敛保证。相比TIC-GRPO，将四阶延迟项阈值依赖从O(ε⁻⁴)改进为O(ε⁻²)（ε→0，1+ε为比值阈值）。局部策略重叠下，调步长后延迟相关项按G⁻²/⁵衰减（G为组大小）。固定行为与当前策略时，组重缩放偏差随G→∞消失，而轨迹级裁剪偏差可能持续。Qwen3模型与推理基准实验显示对陈旧rollout鲁棒性提升，大延迟下GMC-GRPO在稳定基线中最优。

Conclusion: 通过收敛界分析揭示陈旧性经偏差影响收敛，GMC-GRPO以最小化比值偏差界实现更优延迟依赖性，理论与实验均验证其在异步RL大延迟场景下的有效性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves the efficiency of large language model post-training but introduces stale rollouts generated by earlier policies. Theoretical understanding of how this staleness affects convergence and how to mitigate its impact remains limited. We derive a convergence bound for GRPO-style algorithms that explicitly characterizes the tradeoff between the gradient estimator's second moment and bias. For trajectory-level importance-weighted estimators, our analysis shows that once the second moment is uniformly controlled, delay enters the bound through the bias introduced by clipping or rescaling. Guided by this insight, we propose a novel group mass capping GRPO (GMC-GRPO) method, which minimizes a ratio-based bias bound within a class of weighted estimators sharing a common second-moment guarantee. We establish convergence guarantees for asynchronous GMC-GRPO and show that, compared with TIC-GRPO, it improves the threshold dependence of the fourth-order delay term from $O(ε^{-4})$ to $O(ε^{-2})$ as $ε\to0$, where $1+ε$ is the ratio threshold. Under local policy overlap, the delay-dependent term decreases as $G^{-2/5}$ after tuning the step size, where $G$ is the group size. For fixed behavior and current policies, the bias introduced by group rescaling also vanishes as $G\to\infty$, whereas the bias from trajectory-wise clipping can persist. Experiments across Qwen3 models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness to stale rollouts, with GMC-GRPO achieving the best performance among stable baselines under large rollout delays.

</details>


### [255] [A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01801)
*Sahil Kadadekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文审计了一种以"已知安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度"作为安全评分的睡眠代理检测器规则，发现原始正质心规则并未被识别：正样本只能相对编码器原点定位"安全类"，却无法确定区分安全/不安全的真实方向。在两组人工标注语料上安全原型仅达ROC-AUC 0.457–0.545（部分低于随机），而显式"安全减不安全"参考方向在同嵌入下达0.588–0.738；在陪审团控制集上原型反向（0.358–0.405），参考方向达0.754–0.793。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年有睡眠代理检测器提出用响应与"已知安全响应均值嵌入"的余弦相似度作为安全评分。作者旨在审计该评分规则的合理性：质疑正质心（positive centroid）是否真正刻画了安全方向，因为仅依赖正观测只能确定安全类相对编码器原点的位置，而无法确定分离安全与不安全响应的方向，且未经控制评估可能存在提示标签构成导致的虚高。

Method: 在两组提示控制、人工标注语料和一组辅助的陪审团标注源控制上，使用四个冻结编码器与按提示分组的划分进行评估。比较"安全原型（正质心）"与显式"安全减不安全（safe-minus-unsafe）参考方向"两种评分。在验证集校准的5%假安全阈值下比较安全响应接受率；并做完全无标注的留出参考实验、不同不安全比例（仅5%不安全）实验、标注不安全样本数量（80–634条）实验，以及仅提示的消融分析，以检验无控制评估是否被提示标签构成抬高。

Result: 人工标注语料上安全原型ROC-AUC为0.457–0.545，其中两格显著低于随机、一格高于随机；同嵌入下显式安全减不安全参考达0.588–0.738。陪审团控制集上原型反向（0.358–0.405），参考达0.754–0.793。在5%假安全阈值下，参考在PKU-SafeRLHF（0.153–0.263 vs 0.039–0.061）和Aegis（0.189–0.291 vs 0.004–0.045）上接受更多安全响应，但在BeaverTails上不可靠。完全无标注留出参考可恢复部分至大部分排名，当仅5%池不安全时恢复明显更少，而80–634条标注不安全响应可恢复大部分。仅提示消融显示提示标签构成会抬高无控制评估。

Conclusion: 这是一个关于原始正质心的有限结论，并非否定所有单类方法或安全专用护栏。类均值是一种"位置"，不必然是"安全方向"；只有声明一个参考方向并具备足够的不安全样本质量，才能识别出正确的方向。因此以安全均值余弦相似度直接评分安全性的做法缺乏方向性依据，需引入显式安全-不安全参考。

Abstract: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.

</details>


### [256] [On Language Drift during RLVR Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02015)
*Michael Sullivan,Alexander Koller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM推理模型在RLVR后训练中出现的"语言漂移"现象，理论证明RLVR优化压力允许无界语言漂移而监督微调不会，实证表明语言漂移在面向新任务时出现，并证明约束语言漂移必然约束期望奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR显著提升了LLM的复杂任务推理能力，但同时模型思维链(CoT)中出现了语言漂移：非标准、异常甚至无意义的语言使用。这一现象已被记录且可能损害CoT可监控性，但其成因尚不清楚，因此需要系统研究其发生条件与内在机制。

Method: 采用理论分析与实证相结合的方法：(1)理论证明RLVR优化压力与监督微调在语言漂移上的差异；(2)在RLVR训练新推理任务（目标行为无法从基础模型中引出）条件下进行实证观察；(3)理论证明语言漂移约束与期望奖励约束之间的关系。

Result: 理论结果：RLVR优化压力允许无界的语言漂移，而监督微调不会导致此类漂移；语言漂移在面向新颖推理任务的RLVR训练中（基础模型无法引出的目标行为）特定地出现。此外证明无法在不约束期望奖励的前提下约束语言漂移。

Conclusion: 语言漂移是RLVR后训练中内在且难以规避的现象，其成因在于RLVR优化压力及新任务学习。在前沿模型的RLVR后训练中，提升CoT可监控性必然以牺牲性能为代价，两者存在不可调和的权衡。

Abstract: Recent advances in LLM reasoning models---driven primarily by the paradigm of post-training via reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR)---have enabled them to accomplish impressively complex tasks. However, in parallel with their rising capabilities, LLMs have increasingly displayed signs of language drift in their chains of thought (CoTs): unusual, non-standard, and seemingly nonsensical language use. Although it is well-documented---and can potentially impair CoT monitorability---the causes of language drift are thus far poorly understood. In this paper, we identify the conditions under which language drift occurs: we prove theoretically that RLVR optimization pressure permits unbounded language drift, while supervised fine-tuning does not. We then show empirically that language drift specifically arises during RLVR on novel reasoning tasks---i.e. when the target behavior cannot be drawn out of the base model. Finally, we prove that it is not possible to constrain language drift without constraining expected reward, suggesting that CoT monitorability cannot be improved without harming performance during RLVR post-training at the frontier.

</details>


### [257] [Debias Anything: Fairness with Diversity without Supervision in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01815)
*Théau d'Audiffret,Mariia Vladimirova,Jean-Yves Franceschi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种可接于任意扩散模型的适配器方法，将冻结扩散模型连接到预训练视觉-语言嵌入空间，在无敏感属性标注下联合引导公平性与多样性，在相当公平水平下提升生成质量与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型会复现并放大训练数据中的人口统计失衡。现有去偏方法多依赖分类器引导或显式文本额外条件，适用性受限且削弱输出多样性；而单纯促进多样性的方法又不能保证属性表示的公平性。因此需要一种能同时兼顾公平与多样、且普遍适用于任意扩散模型与任意敏感属性的方法。

Method: 通过一个适配器将冻结的扩散模型连接到预训练的视觉-语言嵌入空间，从而无需敏感属性标注即可实现公平与多样性引导。公平性方面，用成对文本提示定义属性方向，将批次组成引导至特定比例；多样性方面，引入一个基于该表示所导出的语义估计之间不一致程度的分数。该形式化支持无条件与文本条件扩散模型，且不需要任何敏感属性的先验知识或数据。

Result: 实验证实，该方法在相当（可比）的公平性水平下，提升了生成图像的质量与多样性分数。

Conclusion: 所提方法对任意扩散模型与任意敏感属性具有通用性，在不需敏感属性标注与先验知识的前提下联合优化公平性与多样性，在保持公平水平的同时改善质量与多样性，为扩散模型的训练后去偏提供了新思路。

Abstract: Although diffusion models produce high-quality images, they also reproduce and amplify demographic imbalances in their training data. Debiasing their generation process post-training w.r.t. some sensitive attribute usually relies on classifier guidance or explicit text extra-conditioning, but this reduces methods' applicability and output diversity. Conversely, methods promoting diversity alone do not ensure fair attribute representation. In this paper, we propose a method tackling fairness and diversity jointly that is generally applicable to any diffusion model and any sensitive attribute. To this end, an adapter connects the frozen diffusion model to a pretrained vision-language embedding space, enabling fairness and diversity guidance without sensitive-attribute annotations. For fairness, pairs of text prompts define attribute directions which guide batch composition towards specific proportions. For diversity, we introduce a score measuring disagreement between the semantic estimates derived from this representation. The formulation supports unconditional and text-conditional diffusion models, while requiring no prior knowledge or data of sensitive attribute. Experiments confirm that our method improves quality and diversity scores at comparable fairness levels.

</details>


### [258] [CARM: Cancellation-Aware Response Masking for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02039)
*Yafei Zhang,Songshuo Lu,Sicong Liao,Zhi Chen,Yaohua Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CARM：在序列级掩码中用绝对对数比率替代几何平均，避免符号抵消，精确刻画偏离策略的响应，在数学推理和代码生成任务上超过几何平均掩码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM后训练中强化学习广泛应用，但策略更新与推理/训练引擎差异导致采样响应偏离策略。序列级掩码用于决定整条响应是否参与优化，常用规则是采样token概率比的长度归一化几何平均，其带符号对数比会在位置间相互抵消，掩盖双向的策略漂移。

Method: 提出Cancellation-Aware Response Masking（CARM）序列级掩码：先对每个token的对数比取绝对值，再进行平均，防止相反方向的概率变化相互抵消。理论上证明被接受的响应满足联合界限：既限制偏离指定区间的采样token比例，也限制超出边界的平均对数距离。

Result: 在数学推理与代码生成实验中，CARM在AIME 2024/2025/2026与BeyondAIME上平均的mean@16较几何平均掩码最高提升3.13个百分点；在四个代码基准上的平均pass@1较最强基线提升2.88个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果支持CARM是一种理论有据且有效的LLM强化学习中响应级偏离策略控制方法。

Abstract: Recent years have witnessed the rapid adoption of reinforcement learning (RL) in large language model (LLM) post-training, with substantial gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation. In practical systems, however, policy updates and differences between rollout and training engines can make sampled responses off-policy. Sequence-level masking addresses this mismatch by deciding whether an entire response should contribute to optimization. A common masking rule uses the length-normalized geometric mean of sampled token probability ratios. Its signed log-ratios can cancel across positions, concealing substantial bidirectional policy drift. We propose \emph{Cancellation-Aware Response Masking} (CARM), a sequence-level mask that takes the absolute value of each token log-ratio before averaging, preventing opposing probability changes from canceling. We prove that accepted responses satisfy a joint bound on the fraction of sampled-token ratios outside a prescribed band and their mean log-distance beyond its boundaries. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that CARM improves mean@16 averaged over AIME 2024/2025/2026 and BeyondAIME by up to $3.13$ percentage points over geometric-mean masking, and increases average pass@1 across four code benchmarks by $2.88$ points over the strongest evaluated baseline. These findings support CARM as a theoretically grounded and effective method for response-level off-policy control in LLM reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [259] [MECHVAR: Variance-Guided Mechanism Discrimination for Autonomous Machine Learning Experiment Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01819)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究有限机制库下的序贯机制判别问题，提出 MECHVAR 采集准则：以候选机制的后验加权预测响应方差选择下一个实验探针，并给出其与 Box–Hill 成对 KL 准则、期望信息增益（EIG）的理论联系及计算效率优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准性能提升往往机制不明确，重复出改进并不能说明其成因；需要一种能在有限实验预算下有效判别候选机制的序贯实验选择方法。

Method: 将问题形式化为：给定后验加权候选机制、可执行探针和有限实验预算，序贯选择探针。MECHVAR 选择使预测响应后验加权方差最大的探针；在共享高斯预测模型下，该分数与经典 Box–Hill 后验加权成对 KL 准则成正比，支持 O(KE) 向量化重评分和机制对的可加审计；局部展开进一步将分数与响应分离较小时的 EIG 关联。

Result: 在 25 块压力审计中，MECHVAR 在若干中等误设情形优于 confirmation-first，但与 EIG 的主要比较在统计上未决。留出 Digits 实验中，机制识别归一化 AUC 为：MECHVAR 0.8975，score-greedy 0.7825，EIG 0.9092。K=100、E=200 时，单线程全库评分中位数 MECHVAR 为 10.36 微秒，六节点求积 EIG 为 57.69 毫秒。

Conclusion: 当共享预测尺度是可接受的近似时，MECHVAR 为有限机制库实验选择提供了轻量、可审计的采集规则；其精度与 EIG 相当但计算成本极低。

Abstract: Benchmark gains are often mechanism-ambiguous: reproducing an improvement does not by itself identify why it occurs. We study finite-library mechanism discrimination, where posterior-weighted candidate mechanisms, executable probes, and a limited experimental budget define a sequential experiment-selection problem. MECHVAR selects the next probe by maximizing the posterior-weighted variance of its predicted responses. Under a shared-Gaussian predictive model, this score is exactly proportional to the classical Box--Hill posterior-weighted pairwise-KL criterion, yet it admits O(KE) vectorized rescoring and a transparent additive audit over mechanism pairs. A local expansion further links the score to expected information gain (EIG) when predicted response separations are small. In a 25-block stress audit, MECHVAR outperforms confirmation-first in several moderate misspecification regimes, while its primary comparisons with EIG remain statistically unresolved. In a held-out Digits loop, normalized mechanism-identification AUC is 0.8975 for MECHVAR, 0.7825 for a score-greedy policy, and 0.9092 for EIG. At K = 100, E = 200, median single-thread full-library scoring is 10.36 microseconds for MECHVAR versus 57.69 ms for six-node quadrature EIG in the recorded environment. MECHVAR therefore provides a lightweight, auditable acquisition rule for finite-library experiment selection when a shared predictive scale is a defensible approximation.

</details>


### [260] [Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02043)
*Jinhwan Sul,Panagiotis Theodoropoulos,Vincent Pacelli,Jaemoo Choi,Evangelos Theodorou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出分布鲁棒薛定谔桥(DRSB)，在初始分布存在不确定性时学习单一控制器，最小化最坏情况下的控制能量与终端分布KL惩罚，并给出精确变分形式与交替优化算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准薛定谔桥(SB)学习从给定初始分布到目标分布的随机传输，但当测试时初始分布发生偏移，学到的动力学无法恢复到目标分布。因此需要一种对初始分布不确定性鲁棒的传输方法。

Method: DRSB目标由控制能量与终端分布对目标分布的KL惩罚构成，在初始分布的模糊集内最小化该目标的最坏情况值。作者推导了该目标的精确变分形式，并将固定终端代价子问题与随机最优控制、分布鲁棒优化相联系。基于此提出交替算法：更新对抗性初始分布、估计终端对数密度比、训练控制器；利用随机控制最优性条件设计Wasserstein与Sinkhorn变体以近似对抗更新所需梯度。

Result: 在二维传输任务与图像到图像翻译实验中，DRSB相对标准SB对输入扰动表现出更好的鲁棒性，但在名义性能上存在权衡。在高斯混合传输上，Sinkhorn DRSB在两个测试的未见噪声水平下，均取得比固定水平噪声增强更低的平均切片Wasserstein距离。

Conclusion: DRSB通过分布鲁棒优化框架统一了薛定谔桥与对初始分布不确定性的鲁棒性，其变分形式与交替算法在保持可行性的同时提升了鲁棒性，代价是名义性能的折衷。

Abstract: Schrödinger bridge (SB) learns stochastic transport between prescribed initial and target distributions. When the initial distribution shifts at test time, the learned dynamics can fail to recover the target distribution. We introduce the Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge (DRSB), which learns a single controller that accounts for uncertainty in the initial distribution. The DRSB objective consists of control energy and a KL penalty between the resulting terminal distribution and the target distribution.
